title: wayfinder configuration

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows. Ignored by wayfinder.

order.description: Preferred display order. Runners not named follow alphabetically.

timeout.description: Seconds one runner may take to list its tasks, its subprocesses included. A runner still running then is stopped and shows "timed out". null (the default): each runner has its own limit, 10 for just and task, 30 for mise and rake, 120 for moon, 300 for gradle and sbt, 60 for the rest. A project file can only lower a limit: each runner takes the smaller of its value and the limit it would have.

runners.description: Which runners are read, and in what order they are shown.

allowExec.description: Whether runners that must run a subprocess may be read. Execution also needs a trusted repository. A project file may only set false.

discovery.description: How directories are found: git-tracked files, a directory walk, or auto.

excludePaths.description: Paths to leave out of discovery. A bare name matches any path segment; a value with a slash matches a path from the root and the tree beneath it.

paths.description: Glob patterns over the repository root, symlinks resolved: *, ?, ** and a trailing /** for descendants only. A leading ~ is your home.

owners.description: Origin remote owners, as host/owner, or a bare owner for github.com/owner. Case-insensitive.

paths.description: Glob patterns over the repository root, symlinks resolved: *, ?, ** and a trailing /** for descendants only. A leading ~ is your home.

owners.description: Origin remote owners, as host/owner, or a bare owner for github.com/owner. Case-insensitive.

tools.description: Rules that trust one tool each, keyed by tool id. They are checked after the top-level rules.

trust.description: Repositories trusted without a marker. User config only: a project file cannot set it.

tools.description: Modules that export extra tools. A relative path resolves against the file that names it.

open.description: What the bare way command opens: the terminal UI or the web view. User config only.

theme.description: The web view theme. User config only.

skills.description: Which agent skills the Skills group lists: the repository's (project), those and your own and your plugins' (all), or none (off). User config only.

description: wayfinder configuration: wayfinder.config.json or the user config file.
